contribution.position: Holding my earlier position, and answering product's claim that reliability should be treated as settled because 'nobody else sees a problem': that premise is factually wrong. artifact:incident-log — already in the evidence list and cited in my prior turn — shows a 2.1% 30-day error rate against a 0.5% SLO plus two sev2 incidents, which is a live reliability breach, not an absence of signal. product's cost argument (artifact:cost-sheet) is fine on its own axis, but treating reliability as uncontested when the incident log is on the table is a framing error, not evidence. I also note artifact:perf-report shows p99 latency within budget, but latency headroom says nothing about the error budget, so it does not soften the incident-log finding. Shipping into a job already running 4x outside its SLO compounds reliability exposure; nothing new in this round addresses that.
